text:
maria: We keep getting onboarding tickets about fetch/undici. Need a single recommendation for the JS SDK.

sam: Runtime-detect: if globalThis.fetch exists use it; otherwise dynamic import undici. Avoid shipping undici to edge/browser.

kevin: Agree. Implementation idea: `async function getFetch(){ if (typeof globalThis.fetch==='function') return globalThis.fetch; try{ const {fetch} = await import('undici'); return fetch;}catch(e){ throw new Error('No fetch available. Install undici or use Node 18+'); } }`

alex: Make undici an optionalDependency and use dynamic import to keep bundlers from pulling it. Also provide a sync-export that throws a clear error for module-eval use.

maria: Typing: publish a small SDKFetch typedef in our types file so consumers without lib.dom still get correct signatures. Don't force consumers to add undici types.

sam: Edge runtimes: never polyfill. If fetch exists, use it. Document Deno/Bun/Cloudflare/Vercel behavior.

kevin: Docs blurb for README: Node 18+: nothing to do. Node <18: `npm i undici` or call `await initSdkFetch()`. Edge: nothing to do. Bundlers: use conditional exports to avoid bundling undici into browser bundles.

alex: Tests: stub global.fetch to ensure we never import undici; run a Node 16 smoke test with undici installed to validate fallback.

maria: Action items: I'll open PR with helper + docs. sam: types PR. kevin: package.json export examples. alex: CI matrix for Node16/18/edge sim.
